programme.desc: Emma starts acting very weird after pricking her finger on a mysterious barb of coral, suddenly becoming ravenous for things like anchovy flavoured fish food! Cleo’s fish, Hector, exhibits the same behaviour. As Hector begins to look very sick, Emma turns into a mermaid at the marine park, swimming about in front of the glass in the viewing area.

programme.title: H2O - Mermaid Adventures, Season 1
programme.desc: More and more plastic bags are polluting Dolphin City Bay, and the turtles mistake the bags for sea-sponges and suffocate on them. Our three mermaids, alerted by their friend Teddy the turtle, tackle the problem. After some unsuccessful attempts, they and Lewis decide to use stronger methods to stir up public opinion.

programme.title: H2O - Mermaid Adventures, Season 1
programme.desc: In the aftermath of a violent storm, Dolphin City looks like a new Bermuda Triangle: boats mysteriously break down or sink in the bay. At the sight of hordes of journalists, the girls investigate, with Lewis’ help. They find out that a lightning bolt from the storm has activated mysterious crystals whose magnetic field disrupts navigation equipment.

programme.title: H2O - Mermaid Adventures, Season 1
programme.desc: When Emma, Cleo and Rikki find out two superstars – Brad Patinson and Scarlett Belladonna - are shooting a film in Dolphin City, directed by the famous Martin Fabiola, they try anything to get on the set. Luckily Zane has been hired by the production! Only Rikki prefers to approach the stars in her own way – underwater of course!

programme.title: H2O - Mermaid Adventures, Season 1
programme.desc: Murray and Burke are inconsolable: their pal Danny the octopus has disappeared! By chance, Cleo finds out that he’s in fact been captured by the Oceanic Center, who are conducting scientific research. Murray puts pressure on the mermaids to get Danny out of there and bring him back to the sea. But Danny doesn’t want to go home.

programme.title: H2O - Mermaid Adventures, Season 1
programme.desc: Why has a whale calf run aground on an isolated beach near Dolphin City? And what’s causing the girls’ migraines? Does it have anything to do with the dolphin twins’ bizarre sickness? During their investigations the mermaids come across a strange fishing boat using illegal technology: an extremely low-frequency military radar device.

programme.title: H2O - Mermaid Adventures, Season 1
programme.desc: Burke the hammerhead shark has broken a tooth. To sooth the pain, he has to come up for air at the surface regularly: but in so doing, he involuntarily shows his fin. Before long a panic wave runs through the citizens of Dolphin City, who think they’ve got a dangerous shark on their hands.

programme.title: H2O : Just add Water, Season 3
programme.desc: A problematic family beach picnic leads Don to end his relationship with Samantha until Cleo encourages him to pursue it.

programme.title: H2O : Just add Water, Season 3
programme.desc: Rikki and Bella hide out at Cleo's to protect themselves from a full moon water attack. Bella's kidnapped by a water tentacle and taken to Mako Island.

programme.title: H2O : Just add Water, Season 3
programme.desc: Cleo defies Lewis' advice and experiments with the magic Moon Pool water. Using her powers, Rikki accidentally gets the water into Cleo's aquarium.

programme.title: H2O : Just add Water, Season 3
programme.desc: Bella's warned to back off from Will as he's on the trail of the girls' mermaid secrets. She gets too close to him and he finally discovers she's a mermaid.

programme.title: H2O : Just add Water, Season 3
programme.desc: Bella helps Will with his free-diving training but when she realises he's more interested in her as a mermaid than a girl, she's hurt.

programme.title: H2O : Just add Water, Season 3
programme.desc: Rikki receives counterfeit money at the cafe and is held captive by criminals on a boat. Bella and Cleo are forced to reveal the trio's secret to Will so they can rescue Rikki together.

programme.title: H2O - Mermaid Adventures, Season 1
programme.desc: In her sleep Cleo creates huge spheres of water that float through the air in Dolphin City, causing chaos. This strange phenomenon is caused by her worries about her Dad, who is on a mission out at sea. And what if Cleo’s worries are real? What if her Dad really has fallen into the hands of dangerous outlaws involved in illegal fishing?

programme.title: H2O - Mermaid Adventures, Season 1
programme.desc: The girls find some turtle eggs on Dolphin City beach: they are too fragile to move, so they take turns watching over them till they hatch. But that's not counting with Miriam and Zane – who are having a beach party!! Meanwhile, underwater, Bernie, cannot bear all the noise and disruption his neighbors are making, and decides to leave his cave and go and stay elsewhere for a bit of a rest.

programme.title: H2O - Mermaid Adventures, Season 1
programme.desc: The White Mermaid is in danger! Her sanctuary, the sunken galleon of Edward the Cruel, is about to be discovered by Stanley Finch, the famous explorer. The girls decide to stop him, and make his boat take another course, towards the sinister underwater stone circle.

programme.title: H2O - Mermaid Adventures, Season 1
programme.desc: After being carried by a current into the underwater stone circle, Rikki is victim of a terrible spell: she cannot turn back into a human! To break the spell, she has to wait for the full moon – in three days’ time!

programme.title: H2O - Mermaid Adventures, Season 1
programme.desc: The Bay prepares for a great excitement: there's soon to be the first great robotics competition organized by the Dolphin City University. The events will take place underwater, and Lewis wants badly to win first prize: enrolment in the Science Faculty! Unfortunately, Zane is also participating, and true to form, can only do it by cheating.

programme.title: Wolfblood
programme.desc: Shannon is worried about the wolves and their safety; now people know they exist, they may be hunted. She plans to inform the Department of the Environment so they can protect the wolves, but first needs proof that the wolves exist and she knows how to get it - Carl’s wolfbait! Maddy and Rhydian are worried, they have to get the bait before Shannon gets her hands on it.

programme.title: Wolfblood
programme.desc: Rhydian unexpectedly returns on the night of the full moon, chased by wild wolfbloods as Tom discovers Shannon spying on the Smiths with a surveillance camera hidden in the Den. Maddy’s overjoyed to have Rhydian back and persuades her parents to help him re-adjust back to life in Stoneybridge.

programme.title: Wolfblood
programme.desc: Maddy finds a strange girl stealing her school clothes from the washing line. The thief turns on Maddy. It’s a wolfblood! Maddy gives chase but Rhydian stops her, recognising the girl as Jana, daughter of Alric. Maddy is shocked to see Jana arrive at school the next day with her uniform on, greeting Rhydian like a long lost “friend”.

programme.title: Wolfblood
programme.desc: Liam’s dad, a farmer, has ploughed up an old skeleton of a wolfblood in mid-transformation – and Liam is boasting about his ancestor being a werewolf hunter. Our Wolfbloods go to investigate. Jana is livid, telling tells the others they have a duty to give it the traditional wolfblood burial.

programme.title: Wolfblood
programme.desc: It’s a lunar eclipse, and Jana is bursting with excitement! This is the ultimate night for Wolfbloods, one where their wolf and their human are finally at one. They become a wolf on the inside, whist remaining - for an hour - human on the outside, apart from veining and yellow eyes. It’s a buzz! Jana invites Rhydian to spend the eclipse with her on the moors, but Rhydian isn’t sure.

programme.title: Wolfblood
programme.desc: Jana, on her way to school, is surprised by Alric. Far from being terrified she flings herself into his arms. Jana hadn't been banished from the pack at all. Alric had sent her in to lure Rhydian into coming back with her. She has taken too long. He wants all three of them to return by the end of the day. In school, Tom is humiliated by Jimi showing off his judo in the gym.

programme.title: Dance Academy, Season 2
programme.desc: The Academy students experience stinging prejudice from the judges during the National Round of the Prix de Fonteyn, just as Sammy’s father visits the competition to watch his son dance for the first time in years.

programme.title: Dance Academy, Season 2
programme.desc: Grace continues to make a play for Zach’s attention, leading her to manufacture a serious accusation; as Christian’s resolve to bounce back from his Prix de Fonteyn elimination drives him toward some reckless behaviour. The winners from the Prix ...

programme.title: Dance Academy, Season 2
programme.desc: Ben tries a variety of tactics in rehearsals for ‘Peter Pan’ to prove to Tara that he’s a leading man, while Kat’s efforts to research her character in the production lead to a realisation about her relationship with Christian.

programme.title: Dance Academy, Season 2
programme.desc: Sammy decides to alter his Prix de Fonteyn solo one day before the start of the International Round, while Tara encounters a new-old nemesis in the girls’ competition.

programme.title: Dance Academy, Season 2
programme.desc: Fighting shock and numbness after a sudden tragedy, Tara is struggling to find her motivation as a dancer. Meanwhile, Abigail attempts to block her grief by immersing herself in a prestigious audition for a contemporary company tour.

programme.title: Dance Academy, Season 2
programme.desc: Abigail and Tara join forces to go head to head with a formidable enemy and Christian has to choose between being with the girl he loves and his desire to escape.

programme.title: The Elephant Princess, Season 1
programme.desc: A remark at mother's day from her sanctimonious sister Zoe that Alex is adopted makes her wonder about her magical biological mother, queen Nefari. After Kuru says Omar knew her best, she travels to Manjipoor alone to question him. Vashan spies on them and magically set a trap, entering the queen's magical posthumous vision.

programme.title: The Elephant Princess, Season 1
programme.desc: Kuru warns Alex the powerful royal rune to shift time back in order to change things has only been used twelve times for extreme emergencies. Reasoning one wouldn't know if the royal user doesn't tell, the scamp keeps abusing it for petty accidents all day when Marcus finally asks her on a real date.

programme.title: The Elephant Princess, Season 1
programme.desc: Kuru tells Alex that Anala's birthday is a grand state affair in Manjipoor, where the elephant chooses one subject to be granted a wish. She offers to his and Omar's delight to preside over the palace party. Told it's invitation only, she magically fakes invitations for her friends and even a few Manjipoor commoner market acquaintances.

programme.title: The Elephant Princess, Season 1
programme.desc: Marcus got the band a gig in his uncle Harry's café, where Zom Records executives have lunch, but the stage is too small, so they must perform a duet by Marcus and Alex, who abuses some minor magic. Omar informs the elders one of Anala's magical headdress jewel was stolen.

programme.title: The Elephant Princess, Season 1
programme.desc: The band bunch prepares for the school's masked dance, an concept unknown to Kuru. JB was turned down by 48 girls, so he's desperate to ask Kosma on the Manjipoor market and tricks Alex to take him there, supposedly looking for her perfect dress, behind Kuru's back.

programme.title: The Elephant Princess, Season 1
programme.desc: Kuru reports to Omar and the council of elders about Vashan's hostile intrusion in the other world, but they can't counter a royal. Meanwhile Vashan has used the magical gem again, and using a box and carpet can prevent being sent back.

programme.title: Dance Academy, Season 2
programme.desc: Tara risks serious injury and possible expulsion to compete in the Prix de Fonteyn Preliminary Round, and Kat is on top of the world when she’s allowed back into the Academy.

programme.title: Dance Academy, Season 2
programme.desc: Whilst recovering from her broken back, Tara discovers a hidden side to Ben who is volunteering in a hospital leukaemia ward performance; and Kat tries to settle into First Year.

programme.title: Dance Academy, Season 2
programme.desc: As Tara negotiates her return to the Academy, Ethan’s search for ongoing employment leads him to accept a position choreographing a fringe musical.

programme.title: Dance Academy, Season 2
programme.desc: Sammy and Ollie’s friendship heads into unchartered territory when they go on a road trip so that Sammy can compete in a Prix de Fonteyn regional round, while Christian joins them to reconnect with his estranged father, Raf.

programme.title: Dance Academy, Season 2
programme.desc: The escalating conflict between the First and Second Years results in a showdown to determine which year has the greatest talent, and Tara becomes unhinged when Grace tempts her to get less serious.

programme.title: Dance Academy, Season 2
programme.desc: During an excursion to the circus, Christian’s dad makes promises he’s unable to keep, Tara tries to repair her friendship with Kat and Sammy goes public about his new romance.

programme.title: Lightening Point
programme.desc: KIKI and ZOEY are anxious – with no reply from Lumina and LUCA knowing who they are, they’re no longer safe in Lightning Point.

programme.title: Lightening Point
programme.desc: Many weeks after the boat was discovered in the cane field, no clues have been found and no further message from Lumina has come.

programme.title: Lightening Point
programme.desc: AMBER is totally excited when her crush, JOSH has noticed her at school. She’s doubly excited when he asks her to help organise a Hawaiian fundraiser party for his basketball team.

programme.title: Lightening Point
programme.desc: When OLIVIA rings AMBER about a surprise waiting at home for her, AMBER would never have guessed that the surprise was her Dad KEITH!

programme.title: Lightening Point
programme.desc: LUCA is finally letting his guard down with KIKI again – and soon they’re back to their old friendship.

programme.title: Lightening Point
programme.desc: The gang decide not to let BRANDON know about the toy lighthouse until they know more about it.

programme.title: H2O : Just add Water, Season 2
programme.desc: Don forces the family to go camping on Mako Island during a Full Moon. Cleo can’t get out of it so invites Emma and Rikki for back-up. Lewis inveigles himself to go too but when he tells Charlotte, she pressures him into taking her as well! The girls are furious with Lewis but he’s in a bind.

programme.title: H2O : Just add Water, Season 2
programme.desc: Emma is annoyed to find the one guy she can’t stand suddenly appearing around the juice bar - Ash. When she thinks she’s going to get a promotion at work, Emma is even more annoyed to find that Ash has been given the job ahead of her. As Emma and Ash clash over how the juice bar is run, we discover it’s over a lot more; they’re secretly attracted to each other.

programme.title: H2O : Just add Water, Season 2
programme.desc: Nate is still trying his best to get Cleo to like him but to no avail. Lewis and Zane find an old myth about mermaids is true - the scent of ambergris sends them wild. Ambergris was once used in perfumes and is deposited by whales, it’s extremely rare but Zane acquires some. Zane’s plan to use it backfires when sleazy Nate gets hold of the scent and quickly has all three mermaid girls on his arm!

programme.title: H2O : Just add Water, Season 2
programme.desc: Lewis has a bad dream about Cleo being discovered as a mermaid. Elliot asks Lewis for advice on girls and Lewis obliges, just to keep him happy. Elliot asks Kim out on a date to the marine park but Kim goes along with it just to take advantage of Elliot paying for everything. When Don forces Cleo to go as chaperone and Elliot begs Lewis to come, Lewis and Cleo find themselves on the date too.

programme.title: H2O : Just add Water, Season 2
programme.desc: Ash keeps trying to ask Emma out but she won’t hear of it - it’s a full moon tonight. Cleo and Rikki goad Ash into being bold with Emma - but they don’t count on him turning up at Emma’s place in time for the full moon! Ash organises a romantic dinner just for him and Emma.

programme.title: H2O : Just add Water, Season 2
programme.desc: It’s one year since the girls became mermaids and Cleo decides to organise a special party just for them but when Zane and Ash clash at the juice bar, Rikki and Emma take their boyfriend’s side in the argument. Soon Emma and Rikki aren’t talking to each other. No matter what Cleo tries, the friendship is still strained.

programme.title: H2O - Mermaid Adventures, Season 1
programme.desc: Rikki has to make up for her mistakes! Convinced that her father’s new girlfriend, Cathy, is dishonest, Rikki sabotages the dinner in which her father tried to ask Cathy for her hand in marriage. To bring the estranged sweethearts back together, Rikki absolutely has to recover the lost engagement ring, which fell into the sea during that tumultuous dinner.

programme.title: H2O - Mermaid Adventures, Season 1
programme.desc: Worrying events agitate the little underwater community of the Bay: clownfish are inexplicably disappearing one after another. The mermaids try to get to the bottom of this mystery, to find their friend Ziggy, a little clownfish who’s among those missing.

programme.title: H2O - Mermaid Adventures, Season 1
programme.desc: Cleo is down in the dumps: she might lose her job at the Oceanic Center, since she said she’s allergic to water, to avoid getting wet in front of Mr. Lambert. Swimming out at sea, she wanders into a strange stone circle – suddenly she wishes she could forget all about this mermaid business. Her wish comes true.

programme.title: H2O - Mermaid Adventures, Season 1
programme.desc: It’s Valentines Day! Lewis and Abby spend the day together like sweethearts. Cleo goes crazy with jealousy. She finds out that Lewis has promised to tell Abby a huge secret. And what if – blinded by love – Lewis were to betray Cleo and her friends, by revealing that they are mermaids?! Emma, Cleo and Rikki have to get to the bottom of this

programme.title: H2O - Mermaid Adventures, Season 1
programme.desc: The inhabitants of the Bay are overwhelmed: one of the dolphin twins, Robby, has disappeared, captured by an unknown speedboat. Bernie calls on our three mermaids for help: the girls were walking around Dolphin City, which is all decked out for the carnival. But why would anyone kidnap a dolphin?

programme.title: H2O - Mermaid Adventures, Season 1
programme.desc: In her sleep Cleo creates huge spheres of water that float through the air in Dolphin City, causing chaos. This strange phenomenon is caused by her worries about her Dad, who is on a mission out at sea. And what if Cleo’s worries are real? What if her Dad really has fallen into the hands of dangerous outlaws involved in illegal fishing?

programme.title: H2O : Just add Water, Season 3
programme.desc: Kim attempts to derail Don and Samantha's wedding. Lewis receives an opportunity to study in America. Cleo realises she's got to let Lewis live his own life and let him go overseas.

programme.title: H2O : Just add Water, Season 3
programme.desc: Will pushes himself too far when Zane challenges him to prove his skills as a free-diver. The girls discover a unique crystal in the rock from the Moon Pool.

programme.title: H2O : Just add Water, Season 3
programme.desc: Sophie uses Bella's idea for a fundraising concert and presents it as her own to Rikki to gain publicity for the cafe.

programme.title: H2O : Just add Water, Season 3
programme.desc: Rikki's frustrated by the water attacks and goes to Mako Island on a full moon to confront the strange force in the Moon Pool.

programme.title: H2O : Just add Water, Season 3
programme.desc: Cleo's introduced to Ryan, a young geophysicist who's working for Samantha. Rikki doesn't react well to Cleo consulting Ryan about the Mako rock and a fracture begins to appear in the trio.

programme.title: H2O : Just add Water, Season 3
programme.desc: Rikki fears Ryan's explorations on Mako Island will uncover their secrets but Cleo and Bella discount her concern.

programme.title: Lightening Point
programme.desc: When ZOEY and KIKI, two irrepressible girls from another galaxy land in Lightning Point, their dreams of surfing the waves of Earth’s oceans have finally come true!

programme.title: Lightening Point
programme.desc: With their space ship obliterated and no other way of getting home, KIKI and ZOEY settle into the teenage world of Lightning Point at AMBER’s house.

programme.title: Lightening Point
programme.desc: To blend in, ZOEY and KIKI start attending AMBER’s school – and find it nothing like school on LUMINA.

programme.title: Lightening Point
programme.desc: When KIKI is moved to tears by AMBER’s singing, AMBER makes an important discovery – Luminans can only experience emotions on Earth.

programme.title: Wolfblood
programme.desc: Maddy is in a mood now that Rhydian has moved out. Her parents are taking her, Shannon and Tom for a day in Blackpool to cheer her up. They stop at small garage called The Mottled Poppy to fill up and get directions. A white poppy on the counter changes colour when Daniel stands next to it and the owner, Bob Driscoll, seemingly friendly, excuses himself and leaves to make a sneaky phone call.

programme.title: Wolfblood
programme.desc: It’s election time for student rep on the school council! Jeffries doesn't expect anyone to be interested but Jana, now determined to be pack leader, throws up her hand. Maddy does too in retaliation. The Ks don’t want either girl being their rep so Kara puts herself forward. Jimi can’t bear the thought of all this girl power and volunteers himself as candidate.

programme.title: Wolfblood
programme.desc: Rhydian, Shannon and Maddy catch Jana breaking into Shannon’s locker before school. Jana defends herself; she HAS to get Shannon’s laptop to destroy the data. Maddy lands on Shannon’s side but secretly, she and Rhydian know that Jana is right; it's a ticking time bomb.

programme.title: Wolfblood
programme.desc: As student rep, Kara is in charge of organising tonight's school disco which she and the other K’s are determined to make the coolest night of the year. Katrina is also excited because she thinks Harry Averwood is to be her date that night. The problem for our Wolfbloods is that there's no moon and all they want to do is sleep.

programme.title: Wolfblood
programme.desc: The class are Camping overnight in Aern Hollow before the orienteering task the next day. Liam has his ancestor's journal with him outlining how he found and tracked the werewolf he shot (ep 3). In their respective tents, Maddy, Jana and Rhydian use their wolfblood hearing to listen in, telling Tom and Shannon what they hear.

programme.title: Wolfblood
programme.desc: The day before school Parents’ Evening, Maddy, Tom, Shannon and Rhydian are helping Jana clean her caravan. Rhydian’s Mother, Ceri, shows up. But it's not just Rhydian she has come to see. She tells Jana that her Father Alric has been deposed by the pack, making Jana the new Alpha. If Jana doesn't assume her destiny as heir, the pack will destroy itself as betas fight for control.

programme.title: Dance Academy, Season 1
programme.desc: Country-girl Tara Webster travels to Sydney to audition for the prestigious National Academy of Dance. It’s a tumultuous week as she realises her dream of becoming a dancer is going to be a lot more difficult.

programme.title: Dance Academy, Season 1
programme.desc: Tara arrives at the Academy excited about the year ahead but soon discovers that she is the worst dancer in the class. As Tara struggles to fit in, she learns the hard way to respect her teachers.

programme.title: Dance Academy, Season 1
programme.desc: When Tara’s crush on Ethan threatens to derail her friendship with Kat, Sammy gets her to write a pros and cons list to clear her head. As the roommate war escalates, Abigail wins a decisive victory - emailing Tara’s list to the whole school.

programme.title: Dance Academy, Season 1
programme.desc: The first years are given trust exercises to help forge connections with their pas de deux partners. Tara is frustrated when Christian refuses to participate, however they connect unexpectedly when Tara follows him to the beach.

programme.title: Dance Academy, Season 1
programme.desc: Sammy is forced to choose between dance and his father when compulsory Saturday ballet classes clash with his Synagogue services. Christian struggles to accept the rules of the Academy.

programme.title: Dance Academy, Season 1
programme.desc: The National Ballet comes to town and Tara is thrilled to learn that Kat’s mother is Natasha Willis, the Company’s Principal dancer and her childhood idol. Sammy’s girlfriend, Mia, also arrives forcing Sammy to evaluate his growing feelings.

programme.title: The Elephant Princess, Season 1
programme.desc: Marcus and Alex want to exchange one month together-gifts. Alex just asks Kuru's wise advice, but Marcus left the choice to Amanda. Kuru generously gives her one the royal Manjipoor coins she admires. Amanda tricks sweet-tooth Anala into transporting her to Manjipoor to buy a diamond necklace.
